category: remote logging for mobile and web apps (hosted)

free_tier.stated: Free plan: 100K logs daily, 2,000 customer devices, unlimited user accounts and apps, 24 hours of retention, remote logging and native SDKs for mobile and web; no crash reporting, no API access and no webhooks
free_tier.notes: The allowance mixes a daily count of logs with a count of customer devices, so no single unit of the vocabulary fits. The Team plan keeps logs 7 days and adds crash reporting; the Pro plan keeps them 30 days and adds API access, webhooks and log archiving to an S3 bucket.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-log-line size is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: 24 hours on Free, against 7 days on Team and 30 days on Pro

egress.terms: logs are read in the dashboard; API access, webhooks and log archiving to an S3 bucket are not part of Free

interface_detail: Logs are sent by native SDKs for mobile and web and read in the dashboard; the pricing table lists API access from the Pro plan, so the Free plan has no API, and the interface vocabulary has no term for an SDK-only service.
tooling: native SDKs for mobile and web, and the web dashboard
chaining: Remote logs from the devices of a free-hosted mobile or web app for 24 hours, up to 100K log lines a day, without a self-run log pipeline.

limits.value: 100K logs daily and 2,000 customer devices on Free

limits_note: Free has no crash reporting, no API access, no webhooks and no log archiving to S3.
binding_note: Logs disappear after 24 hours, so the free tier is a one-day debugging window whatever the volume.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page states no credit card is needed and asks for a name, an email address and a password, or GitHub sign-in. Whether a later step asks for a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: logs older than 24 hours are deleted on the Free plan
confidence_note: Plan limits are quoted from the first-party pricing page and the sign-up fields from the sign-up page. No account was opened, so any later sign-up step is unverified: behind a sign-up.
